name: Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends bugs of the original Typer Shark and leaves the game as it was: its rules, scores, sounds and pace. Each fix is a toggle; turn the whole mod off to play the original exactly as it was.

settings.label: Schools of background fish
settings.help: Fish swim behind the diver in schools of up to four. The original puts the followers of a school far off the right edge, so only the first fish of each school ever shows. Only the first fish of a school counts toward the limit that decides when the next school comes, as in the original, so a game's words and waves stay the same.

settings.label: Typing tutor: the keyboard picture
settings.help: The 8 and * keys light their own key, and { } and _ light the shift key, with the right little finger and its ring for _. The original lights the 9 key at the 8 key's place and shows no shift for these.
